intro: Across 64 articles spanning 2026-04-08 to 2026-10-10, ZCyberNews coverage of social engineering tracks ClickFix, Lazarus Group, and UNC6692 alongside CVE-2023-36036, CVE-2025-24054, CVE-2025-33053, and CVE-2026-21513. Financial services, cryptocurrency, technology, financial-services, and government rank among the most affected sectors, with incidents reported globally and across North america, United states, Europe, and United kingdom. Severity skews high: 49 high, 11 medium, one critical, and two informational. The archive examines how manipulation tactics, rather than software flaws alone, continue to shape intrusion attempts against these sectors and regions.
